authorship: Original sculpted supporting cast authored with project-owned contour, topology, materials, weights and animation tools
rig: Original 25-bone protagonist rig with unchanged names/parents

ada.role: Ada, the fair and kitchen caretaker
individual_sculpt_changes: Broader softened jaw and lowered cheek silhouette
Swept gray crown with a low asymmetric sculpted bun
Wide curved linen work apron, separate bib, straps and worn pocket
Eye creases and restrained silver hair flow
Narrower chin, taller face and fuller nose plane
Tucked side-parted bob with individually swept locks
Curved rounded-square glasses, bridge and temple arms
Practical shorter apron with utensil pocket and offset ties

rafi.role: Rafi, the workshop worker; generic Journey workers
individual_sculpt_changes: Wider angular jaw and broader nose contour
Cropped uneven hair with five authored tousled clumps
Shaped work overshirt and two chest patch pockets
Shortened rolled sleeves with skinned exposed forearms

conductor.role: The conductor at the return platform
individual_sculpt_changes: Longer square lower face and quiet age creases
Neat salt-and-pepper hair and separate sculpted moustache
Original tailored conductor cap with curved visor and band
Long green uniform coat, broad lapels and brass closure

jo.role: Jo at the station; generic Journey keepers
individual_sculpt_changes: Small tapered jaw, fuller cheek plane and wider soft nose
Short coiled crown with original interlocking raised curl paths
Fitted station waistcoat over cream work shirt
Brass station badge, inset front panels and tailored back silhouette

limits: Simplified project-authored stylized geometry, no borrowed assets
Original 25 bones; no finger bones, facial blendshapes or terrain IK
Aprons are skinned cloth without cloth simulation
